construct_policy: build a deterministic policy network for trifinger tasks given state type, goal type, and output dimensions
create_DeterministicPolicy: create a 3-layer ReLU MLP policy network that maps state inputs to action outputs with optional action clipping
create_ScaledDeterministicPolicy: create a Tanh-activated MLP policy network with per-dimension min/max action scaling and clipping support
run_DeterministicPolicy_forward: run a DeterministicPolicy forward pass to compute actions from a given state tensor
reset_DeterministicPolicy: reset a DeterministicPolicy or ScaledDeterministicPolicy network weights back to their initial state
